top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards the magic-wavelength optical lattice clock to Katori and Ye, a distinct idea that has been independently confirmed near the 10^-18 level by RIKEN/Tokyo, JILA, PTB, NIST and SYRTE, with a clean two-name allocation and a citation that can be worded to stay clear of the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. P002 is a strong, mature conceptual prize but its trio sits uneasily with the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang proposal and the 3D work, so I rank it second and any award above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no tie to Katori, Ye, Kane, Mele or Molenkamp (my field proximity is to gamma-ray and astroparticle candidates, which are not on this slate)
